item.title: Nico Collins: Status 'very much in doubt'
item.description:
Collins (hamstring) is "very much in doubt" for Sunday's game against the Colts, Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Jayden Daniels: Should avoid injured reserve
item.description:
Commanders GM Adam Peters, via JP Finlay of NBC Sports Washington, said Friday morning that "as of right now surgery is not on the table" for Jayden Daniels (elbow) and that the team "has not discussed" placing him on injured reserve.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: MarShawn Lloyd: Limited to 18 total yards in loss
item.description:
Lloyd rushed four times for 11 yards and brought in two of three targets for seven yards in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday.

item.title: Kyle Pitts: Limited to one catch in win
item.description:
Pitts secured one of two targets for five yards in the Falcons' 35-14 win over the Packers on Thursday.

item.title: Tucker Kraft: Modest production with four catches
item.description:
Kraft secured four of eight targets for 26 yards in the Packers' 35-14 loss to the Falcons on Thursday. He also recovered a fumble.
